notes.title: Honesty and clarity
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear Messengers,
[/b][/h2][p]It’s been just over three months since [b]Ostera: The curse of…[/b] launched in Early Access. Aside from a few initial bug fixes, [b]no new content updates[/b] have been released yet.[/p][p]Our social media channels have been quiet. Many players know this kind of silence—and for an early access game, that’s rarely a good sign.[/p][p]So, it’s time we shared some [b]honest context and clarity[/b] with you.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Who are we?
[/b][/h3][p]Just a tiny team:[/p][list][*][p]A writer[/p][/*][*][p]A developer[/p][/*][*][p]An artist[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]What happened after release?
[/b][/h3][p]On [b]March 29[/b], Ostera launched in Early Access. We received incredible support from so many [b]streamers and content creators[/b]. It truly warmed our hearts, and seeing your live feedback helped us fix lots of little issues right away.[/p][p]Then came the sales...[/p][p]Despite the energy poured into the project by streamers, viewers, and supporters — [b]the game didn’t sell well[/b].[/p][p]And as many of you probably know: [b]no sales = no income[/b] = a tough time continuing development full-time.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Where are we now?
[/b][/h3][p]For the past few months, [b]Ostera has become a side project[/b] — something we work on during weekends or holiday breaks when we find the time.[/p][p]But [b]don’t worry[/b] — we haven’t abandoned the game!
It might not get all the content or small features we originally envisioned, [b]but it [i]will[/i] have a proper ending[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Why such low sales?
[/b][/h3][p]We’ve identified [b]three major reasons[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Early Access[/b]: Launching a story-driven game as our debut title in Early Access was a big gamble — and a tough sell.[/p][/*][*][p][b]First-time creators[/b]: Ostera is our first-ever release. We had no previous audience, no communication experience, no community… and that matters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]An unconventional game[/b]: Ostera doesn’t fit neatly into the "graphic novel" mold. It’s not the kind of game most players are used to — and even we had trouble defining it at times.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b]Why did we wait this long to say something?
[/b][/h3][p]We wanted to give it a few months before speaking out. We also didn’t want to share emotional reactions or get too personal too soon.[/p][p]But now, we believe it’s important that [b]every current and future player knows the full context[/b] — what they’re buying, and in what conditions Ostera will leave Early Access.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]The bottom line?
[/b][/h3][p][b]Ostera is not abandoned.[/b]
Out of respect for:[/p][list][*][p]our [b]backers[/b][/p][/*][*][p]the [b]streamers[/b] who believed in us[/p][/*][*][p][b]you[/b], the players who bought the game[/p][/*][*][p]and for [b]ourselves[/b], because we put our hearts into this project…[/p][/*][/list][p]We [i]will[/i] finish what we started.[/p][p]This [b]summer[/b], we’ll have more time to focus on upcoming chapters.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you so much for taking the time to read this.[/p][p]Wishing you a wonderful day,[/p][p][b]The Profits Troll Studio Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch - Achievements and Steam Cloud!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I hope you're all well! 

It's been 3 weeks now since Ostera: The curse of... was released on Early Access. 

We've had a plethora of wonderful feedback in comments and streams. 

Thank you so much! 

Wishlists have exploded, which warms our hearts! 

About today's update: 

- We've fixed the bug at the end of the last ‘A few minutes later’ expedition,
- We've corrected a few spelling mistakes in French,
- We've added the ‘Steam cloud’ feature for your backups,
- We've added 11 new achievements! Of course, more will be added as we go along! 

So there you have it, a small but welcome update. 

Don't hesitate to comment, we're now listed as ‘positive’ and that's great! 
Next step, ‘Very positive’! 

Have a nice day, 

Greetings from France!

notes.title: First update - Steam Cloud added
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you for your purchase and support! 

Here's the very first update for Ostera: The curse of...

We've listened to and taken on board all the feedback you've given us via the various streams. 

Many of the French spelling mistakes have been corrected.

We're also delighted to announce the Steam cloud feature for your backups! 

There may be a problem with your first saves, but don't worry, it won't happen again.

Thanks in advance for your feedback, 

Have a nice day, 

Profits Troll Studio
